interface.title: Asteroid Hunter
interface.field: Astronomy: planetary science, small-body (asteroid/NEO) detection and astrometry
interface.stage_of_work: Observation planning, image analysis (moving-object detection), candidate vetting, and early orbit determination
interface.what_it_is_for: Find moving asteroids in a set of same-field telescope FITS frames, either with an automated align-detect-track pipeline or by ear with a sonified shift-and-stack hunt. It also ranks tonight's near-Earth asteroid targets, shows their 3D orbits and hazard figures, and pools RA/Dec observations from several observers into a Gauss-method orbit fit.

data.note: Uploaded the four set203 FITS frames (o6357g0257o…, o6357g0279o…, o6357g0301o…, o6357g0323o…) to /detect. The upload tool reported a timeout, but the form showed '4 files' and detection ran: 3 moving objects in 4 frames, all labelled 'not in catalog' (the SkyBoT cross-match had no network). The triage list and orbit viewer did show live or cached JPL/Sentry data (1668 visible NEOs at the Bengaluru default). The orbit-campaign observations were coordinates I made up (RA 188.5→188.1°, Dec 12.58→12.72°, over three nights from Bengaluru and San Diego).

tree.general: Find moving solar-system objects in repeated images of one sky field, vet them, and turn them into identified objects with orbits
tree.specific: Upload FITS frames, detect and confirm asteroid candidates by pipeline and by ear, look up known NEOs' orbits and hazard, and fit orbits from shared astrometry

features.name: Frame blink comparator with candidate overlays
features.general: Flip through registered images of the same scene so that changes stand out against static background, zooming and panning while it animates, with detected items circled and clickable
features.specific: Inspect & blink the frames: candidate circles (#1/#2/#3) on aligned FITS frames, ▶ Play/Pause blink, ◀ Prev / Next ▶, Blink speed slider, ＋/－ Zoom, drag to pan, ⟲ Reset, ⛶ Fullscreen; clicking a circle gives the candidate's catalog/orbit status
steps: click a candidate circle to select it and see its catalog status
step frames with Prev/Next or press Play to blink
zoom with ＋ Zoom and drag to pan onto the candidate
keep blinking while zoomed to confirm motion
Reset to the full view
serves_tasks: Visually verify candidates by blinking the aligned frames

features.name: Moving-object candidate list
features.general: List of tracked detections, each with rate, position, a quality metric and a cross-match status
features.specific: Result list '#N · rate″/day · (x,y) · conc=…' with 'not in catalog' or a SkyBoT name, plus an 'All frames side by side' matplotlib figure with coloured markers
steps: upload 3–10 frames and press Detect
read each candidate's rate, pixel position and concentration
check the catalog-match label
compare markers across the side-by-side frames
serves_tasks: Upload a set of same-field images and run detection
Review detected candidates' positions, rates and catalog status

features.name: Sonified shift-and-stack hunt (roam mode)
features.general: Explore an image by pointer or keyboard while a live score, computed by stacking all frames along the best-fitting motion at the cursor, is played as sound and shown as text, so faint movers can be found without seeing them
features.specific: Hunt by ear: Start listening (bright stars are excluded first), move with mouse/arrows (Shift for big steps), and read the 'roam · x · y · score · best track ″/day @ angle' line; Speech toggle, P to speak position, V to speak speed and direction
steps: press Start listening and wait for bright-star exclusion
move the cursor with the mouse or arrow keys
listen and watch for the score to rise
read the best-track rate and direction at the peak
serves_tasks: Roam the field by keyboard/mouse while a live stack score guides you to a mover

features.name: Mark-and-confirm frame-by-frame track
features.general: Commit a guessed moving object, then step through each frame along the predicted track, confirming it with a per-frame score, so it is kept only if it shows up in every frame
features.specific: Space marks a candidate at the cursor, then Space once per frame ('confirming candidate · frame k of 4 · this frame alone = …'); the confirmed object gets a green circle and the hunt returns to roam
steps: roam to a high-scoring spot
press Space to mark
press Space for frame 2, 3, 4 as the cursor follows the predicted track
see the green confirmed circle and repeat for another object
press Enter to finish
serves_tasks: Mark a candidate and confirm it in each frame

features.name: Guided detect-by-ear review of the pipeline's detections
features.general: Accessible, guided pass over items an automated detector has already found: it reveals how many there are and marks them, you click the moving dot in each frame with audio feedback, then get a spoken and written summary
features.specific: 🔊 Detect by ear on the results page: Start listening, click to lock per frame (F1–F4 rings), 'Asteroids found: n of 3', Finish now / Esc, Speech on/off; the summary gives RA/Dec and rate for found candidates. The Finish/summary step is flaky: in a replay Finish now showed nothing and Esc reported no asteroids found after one had been found
steps: press Start listening
click (or arrow + Enter) on the mover in frame 1
follow it through frames 2–4
press Finish now to read the summary with RA/Dec and rate (unreliable)
serves_tasks: Guided, audio-assisted review: find the automated detector's own candidates frame by frame

features.name: Hunt review: match against reference and per-candidate blink
features.general: After a manual search, compare each user-found item with the hidden reference detections (agreement in rate), then blink the frames with one chosen item highlighted
features.specific: Your results page: per-candidate card (position, ″/day at angle, hunt score, 'matches a known object… moving 745″/day'), Highlight dropdown, ▶ Blink/Stop, ← previous / next → frame
steps: press Enter to finish hunting
read each candidate's match verdict and rate agreement
choose a candidate in Highlight
step or Blink the frames to watch its circle follow the moving dot
serves_tasks: Review the session's results against the reference detections and blink each confirmed candidate

features.name: Observing-target triage list
features.general: Rank catalog objects for a site, date and sensitivity limit by a transparent priority score (staleness × hazard × brightness × approach × arc), with pointing coordinates and an expandable score breakdown
features.specific: Triage brain: lat/lon/alt/date/Vmag form + Update; summary chips (visible NEOs, on Sentry list, date, Vmag ≤); ranked cards with SENTRY tag, priority, 'Point your telescope here' RA/Dec and transit time, '▸ Show the scoring math', and a link to the 3D orbit
steps: enter site coordinates and limiting magnitude
press Update
read the ranked cards and pointing RA/Dec
expand the scoring math for a card
open the target's orbit page
serves_tasks: Rank candidate targets for an observing site and brightness limit
Inspect why a target was ranked where it is

features.name: Animated 3D orbit viewer with true-distance and impact-odds popup
features.general: Animated, not-to-scale 3D view of an object's orbit against Earth's, with time scrubbing, and a popup giving the true distance on the chosen day and the published impact probability
features.specific: Orbit of <name>: Pause/Play, Time slider, −1d / +1d, Orbit speed and Zoom sliders, Reset; click 'Day N · date' for real distance (km/AU) and NASA Sentry cumulative odds with '▼ See percentage'; side panel 'Point your telescope here' with RA/Dec, transit and rise/set
steps: open the orbit page from a target
Pause the animation and step ±1 day or scrub Time
Zoom in or out
click the date to read real distance and Sentry odds
expand the percentage
serves_tasks: Open an object's orbit view and read its hazard figures
Optional view controls: step through time and zoom the orbit animation

features.name: Shared observation log with orbit-fit status
features.general: No-login shared record where several contributors add timestamped sky positions with site coordinates; a status panel says whether there is enough data (≥3 observations spanning more than one night) and shows the fit or why it failed
features.specific: Campaign page: share link, Add an observation (RA/Dec decimal or sexagesimal, UTC time, lat/lon/alt, name, note), observation list with per-row 🗑 Delete, 'Not enough data yet' / '⚠ No orbit yet' Gauss-fit panel, Delete this campaign
steps: start a campaign with a label and copy the share link
add observations from different nights and sites
watch the status panel move from 'Not enough data' to a fit attempt
delete a bad observation and see the status revert
serves_tasks: Start a shared campaign for an object
Submit position measurements from several nights and sites
Remove a bad measurement and see the fit status update

features.name: Campaign directory and search
features.general: Browsable list of shared observing records, ordered by popularity and recent activity, with a text search by label or ID so others can find a record to contribute to
features.specific: /campaigns: Trending and Recently active lists (observation count, last activity) and a search box (label or ID) giving Search results
steps: open the campaigns list
browse Trending / Recently active
search by label or ID and open the matching campaign
